_comment: judge_spec_template.json — contract for theloop dual-judge runs. Copy and customise for your artifact.

criteria.description: Short description of what must appear in the artifact.
criteria.look_for: Concrete visual cue: shape, colour, position, label, size, contrast, etc.
What to look for when viewing the rendered PNG.

criteria.description: A nice-to-have criterion that should not block delivery.

_schema.run_id: string — unique snake_case identifier, used in critique.json filenames
_schema.max_iters: int — hard budget; loop stops here regardless of score
_schema.score_threshold: float 0-1 — global average threshold; ALL criteria averages must reach this AND all blocking per-criterion thresholds must be met
_schema.visual_judge.enabled: bool — if false, skip visual judge and use ASCII only
_schema.visual_judge.fallback_to_ascii: bool — if vision unavailable, run ascii_view.py and pass scores with --ascii-fallback
_schema.visual_judge.merge_strategy: 'visual_authoritative' — final_score = visual_score; ascii_score stored as audit only
_schema.visual_judge.svg_fix_format: 'exact' — svg_fixes entries must include element name + attribute + value; vague instructions are dropped with a warning
_schema.criteria[].id: string — unique snake_case identifier, matches critique.json and response JSON
_schema.criteria[].description: string — human-readable criterion shown in the inspection prompt
_schema.criteria[].look_for: string — explicit visual inspection hint: what element, colour, position, label to look for in the PNG
_schema.criteria[].weight: float — relative weight for weighted_score computation; default 1.0
_schema.criteria[].visual_threshold: float 0-1 — per-criterion pass bar; must be met for delivery when blocking=true
_schema.criteria[].blocking: bool — true (default): delivery blocked when final_score < visual_threshold; false: soft-fail, flagged but not blocking

_critique_response_schema_visual._comment: JSON the model pipes into --ingest after viewing the PNG (vision mode).

criteria.visual_observations: one sentence: exactly what you see for this criterion in the rendered PNG
svg_fixes: Exact SVG edit — must include element name + attribute + value.
Example: "Add <circle cx='512' cy='320' r='6' fill='#FFD700'/> for maang tikka"
Example: "Change stroke-width from 2 to 5 on all <circle stroke='#FFD700'>"

_critique_response_schema_ascii_fallback._comment: JSON the model pipes into --ingest --ascii-fallback (vision unavailable).

criteria.ascii_observations: one sentence: what you infer from the ASCII luminance map
svg_fixes: exact SVG edit, or [] if passing
